description: This source file defines the RetrieveAttributeLiveCommand interface, which extends other command interfaces to facilitate live retrieval of attributes in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides a method to get the JSON pointer of the attribute to be retrieved.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributeLiveCommand
classes.description: An interface representing a live command for retrieving an attribute, providing access to the command specifics and attribute pointer.

methods.name: getAttributePointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer of the attribute to retrieve.
